chunks: That was narrated - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Al-Hasan ibn Salih from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The caller of the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) called out to the people on the day of Awtas: 'Purify your female captives with one menstruation.' And when a man buys a girl who is pregnant, it is not permissible for him to have intercourse with her in the vagina until she gives birth to what is in her womb, and it is permissible for him to have intercourse with her in what is below the vagina, and if he avoids that as well, it is more excellent.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on consummating marriage with a pregnant female slave in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the ruling of *tabarru'* (purification) for purchased female slaves, mandating a waiting period until childbirth before vaginal intercourse to ensure lineage clarity, while permitting non-vaginal intimacy. It links this legal principle to a historical proclamation by the Messenger of God at the Battle of Awtas, emphasizing the practical application of purification rites in early Islamic society.
